title: Lists with LazyColumn: keys, scrolling and pagination

videos.script: A year of study sessions is a long list. This lesson is about showing it without building all of it. {{lazy}} A Column composes every row it is given. A LazyColumn composes only what is on the screen. A test counts both: a thousand rows, and fourteen. {{keys}} Then keys. Without one, the list knows its rows by position. Open one session, add another above it, and the wrong session is open. A test shows it happening. {{sections}} Then a header for each day, pinned while its sessions scroll under it. {{state}} Then the scroll position, as state you can read. Which item is at the top, and which header is drawn over it. {{more}} And last, loading the next page as the student nears the end. The first version of that code had a bug, and this lesson keeps the line that fixed it.
